decision: UI-only availability and reason metadata with no discovery-result schema change

api_boundary.count_semantics: Existing option counts remain records in all_matching_records_before_pagination. UI-only controls omit count when the current response does not contain the value.
api_boundary.filter_semantics: Canonical section/value tokens use source, geography, access_status, unit_of_analysis, and capability; values retain canonical record IDs. Same-section selections are OR; sections are AND.

behavior.unknown_label: Include records with unresolved geography (if present)
behavior.selected_tokens: Selected tokens are retained and removable when narrowed responses omit their current value, including zero-result responses.
behavior.availability_reasons: Unknown-only geography and uniform public_catalog access receive scoped current-result explanations; the UI makes no global absence or payload-access claim.
behavior.fallback_scope: Fixture counts are explicitly bounded to the accepted response records.
